subject: problem: plotting qq plots with group and geom_step or geom_line are used

messages.author: e70db413cf8fe090
messages.subject: problem: plotting qq plots with group and geom_step or geom_line are used
parts:
I would like to produce a qq plot using stat_qq with 2 groups on the plot
and points connected by steps (geom_step) or lines (geom_line).
Below is a sample code.

df <- data.frame(
x = rnorm(50),
trt = sample(c("a", "b"), 50, rep = T)
)
qplot(sample=x, data=df, stat="qq", dist=qnorm, geom="step", colour = trt)

With ggplot2 v0.6, it worked as expected: see file "qq
ggplot2v0.6R2.6.2.eps"
But with ggplot2 v0.8.3 it works incorrectly: see file "qq
ggplot2v0.8.3R2.9.0.eps"

Does anyone knows a way to circumvent this problem.

Thank you in advance for any help!

Best regards,
Michel Grzebyk
